remarks: Nestled on Nearwater Lane just moments from the beach, this beautifully renovated 5-bedroom/5 and a half bath home offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and functionality. Step inside to discover a thoughtfully designed floor plan that flows effortlessly from room to room. The heart of the home is the stunning, fully renovated kitchen-complete with top-of-the-line appliances, sleek finishes, and ample space for entertaining. Each of the five spacious bedrooms offers comfort and privacy. A finished lower level with a gym & playroom completes the picture. The expansive three-car garage provides even more space for your vehicles and gear. Outside, a sparkling pool awaits in your private backyard oasis-perfect for relaxing or hosting summer gatherings after a day at the beach. With its unbeatable location, exceptional features, and timeless style, this home is a rare opportunity you won't want to miss. Schedule your private showing today!
